Sub:  Intimation of Earnings Conference Call for Financial Performance for the 2nd Quarter 
ended 30 September 2026 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations and other 
applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we would like to inform you that the Earnings 
Conference Call (“Earnings Call”) of the Company to discuss the financial results for Q2 & H1 FY27 
has been scheduled as under: 
S. No. 
Type of Meeting 
Date 
Mode of attending 
1 
Earnings Conference Call to discuss 
the financial results of the Company 
for Q2 & H1 FY27  
Thursday, 22 October 
2026 at 04:00 p.m. 
(IST) 
Via Dial in/ Audio 
Conference Call 
 
The Conference Call Invite for the above conference is also enclosed. 
 
A copy of this schedule of the meeting is also placed on the website of the Company at 
www.himadri.com   
 
Discussions will be based strictly on publicly available information, and no unpublished price sensitive 
information shall be disclosed. 
 
Note: The above schedule of meeting may undergo changes due to exigencies on the part of the Investors 
or the Company.  
 
We request you to kindly take on record the same 
 
Thanking You, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
